name: @craserf/jj-wasm
description: Private browser/WebAssembly package for testing Jujutsu in web apps

scripts.typecheck:jj-wasm: tsc --allowJs --checkJs --noEmit --skipLibCheck --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ESNext --lib ESNext,DOM npm/jj-wasm/index.js npm/jj-wasm/worker-client.js npm/jj-wasm/worker.js
scripts.verify:jj-wasm-package: npm run build:jj-wasm && npm run typecheck:jj-wasm && npm --prefix jj-wasm/web-tests run build:wasm && npm --prefix jj-wasm/web-tests run build
scripts.verify:jj-wasm-all: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p jj-wasm && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p jj-wasm -- -D warnings && cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p jj-lib --no-default-features && cargo test -p jj-wasm && npm run verify:jj-wasm-package && npm run test:jj-wasm-browser && npm run smoke:jj-wasm-package
